description:
Lawful development: Proposed use.
The proposed activity will be limited to the resident using one room, one computer and a telephone to receive and manage bookings and maintain records for Chauffeur Me Ldn Ltd. Bookings may be received and managed 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

The property will remain occupied as a residential dwelling. There will be no customer visits, non-resident staff or other drivers working from the premises, building works or physical alterations. The business will initially involve the resident as the sole driver and one private hire vehicle.

The administrative activity is considered ancillary to the residential use, with no significant change to the character of the property or significant increase in traffic, noise or disturbance anticipated. On this basis, it is considered that no material change of use requiring planning permission would occur. A certificate is sought to confirm the lawfulness of this proposed use.
